provenance.name: The Downballot
provenance.source_total_definition: Publisher total, generally excluding write-ins; Democratic, Republican and nonmajor/unlisted residual preserved.
provenance.license_note: Factual election tallies with source attribution; no blanket license for publisher text, branding or software is asserted.
limitations: Presidential counts reconstructed by The Downballot on district lines the publisher declares applicable to the 2026 midterms.
The publisher uses precinct-level returns, split-precinct estimates and allocation of unassigned votes; these are not independently certified district totals.
The publisher generally excludes write-in votes except unusually high cases; reported_total is not asserted to include every valid presidential vote.
other_votes is the source total minus Democratic and Republican tallies: a nonmajor/unlisted residual, not a named candidate roster.
All 435 source district identities match the AP-published 2026 layout. The AP geometry underlying boundary vintage has not been independently verified.
Missing 2020 district tallies stay absent; older district-number matches are not substituted.
